scope: G8_CAMPAIGN_ONLY; G7 was not repeated in this run

cases.reason: Each private ledger produced 10 exclusive BTC addresses, Monero subaddresses, or Nano accounts. Ten exact atomic payments per currency remained unpublished until the adapter confirmation gate passed; all 30 signed campaigns were stored exactly once on the local Geode relay.

BTC ignored an unrelated address and a currency mismatch, withheld publication at zero confirmations, and a private regtest block invalidation before engine reconciliation reduced the transaction to the pending state. No campaign event was published before reconsideration and reconfirmation.

The wallet credited an exclusive Monero subaddress only after the configured 10-confirmation/unlock gate; repeated lookup returned the same transaction and amount. A private fakechain pop before campaign reconciliation kept the campaign unpublished.

The local Nano dev ledger kept a one-raw transfer uncredited before confirmation, processed it into its unique account after confirmation, and repeated polling returned the same source block while the account balance remained exactly one raw.

All three chains produced signed underpayment refund requests bound to the offer and actual payment. Each real wallet broadcast at most one refund, reported its fee/atomic amount, and a repeated signed request returned the same confirmed transaction after the chain advanced.

Observed payment and refund amounts remained integer atomic values on BTC/XMR and raw on Nano. Campaigns stayed unpublished while settlement was pending, mismatched refund amounts were rejected before any broadcast, and fee amounts were recorded separately for reconciliation.

BTC/XMR local RPCs required credentials, the Nano loopback gateway rejected unauthenticated and incorrect credentials, and each adapter rejected a wrong network before creating a payment address. Random credentials and the test-only dev genesis key were excluded from reports and signed events.

chain_specific_checks.BTC: regtest; pre-activation reorg remained unpublished until reconfirmation
chain_specific_checks.XMR: fakechain/offline; 10-confirmation/unlock gate and chain pop checked
chain_specific_checks.XNO: dev with zero peers; one-raw payment/account isolation checked

privacy.third_party_analytics: not present in inspected campaign paths

limitations: No public relays, mainnet, external endpoints, or real funds were used.
The report omits private RPC credentials, payment addresses, and raw transaction references.
The operator JSON-RPC stdio API is embeddable; the plain Geode launcher does not start it.
Automated fixtures are not a human security audit or a trustless escrow guarantee.
